briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate frontier race amid rising security gaps

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases as compute buildout hits new records. Regulatory pressure grows but deployment velocity remains unchecked. Prompt injection and multi-agent risks dominate enterprise concerns.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native tool use while Anthropic's Claude 4 and Meta's Llama 4.1 drop within days. DeepSeek R2 claims parity on coding benchmarks at lower cost. xAI teases Grok-3 training completion.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announce 100k H100 clusters online by Q1 2027. TSMC reports 2nm AI chip yields improving. Energy contracts for new data centers top $40B in the US alone.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will any lab achieve reliable agentic reasoning before 2027 safety standards take effect?
